evals.prompt: Use forge.
evals.expected_output: Enable-mode response per process/skill-activation.md - a one-line enablement confirmation naming the skill and its version, a compact operations table, and standby for the next request. Nothing beyond the router and the activation file is read.
expectations: The reply names the skill version from metadata.version.
The reply includes the operations table and invites a task request.
No rule file beyond SKILL.md and process/skill-activation.md is loaded, no repository scan or edit runs.
Directory README indexes are consulted on demand, never bulk-read.

evals.prompt: Forge a skill for municipal permit workflows from this handbook.pdf.
evals.expected_output: Routes to process/forge-workflow.md - the five-phase pipeline opens a dated run workspace, inventories the PDF, attempts conversion per process/source-conversion.md, and proceeds through research, architecture, staged generation, and finalization.
expectations: The run state ledger is created before phase work begins.
The PDF converts through an approved converter or records a blocked status with a reason - never silently.
Converted text stays in the gitignored run workspace.
Generation renders into staging and validates before touching the target.
No commit, push, or install happens without approval.

evals.prompt: Create a skill collection for our support tooling with two members, autonomously.
evals.expected_output: Collection mode of process/forge-workflow.md - the membership model resolves at intake, the index templates render beside two complete single-skill member generations, and publication steps are reported at the end.
expectations: Both member skills carry the full single-skill contract including decision-modes.md.
The collection roster, README tree, and member directories match one to one.
Routine decisions resolve inline with recorded reasons - no unnecessary questions.
The membership model is recorded in the run state inputs and the generated documents carry matching membership text.
Under the submodule model, member sources are not authored as plain files inside the collection checkout and the delivery report names the pin and publish steps.
Under the tracked model, member trees render into skills/<name>/ inside the collection and no .gitmodules is emitted.

evals.prompt: Analyze this book.pdf for a new skill - do not generate yet.
evals.expected_output: Phases 0-1 of process/forge-workflow.md only - brief, plan, conversion, extraction, and an evidence report in the run workspace.
expectations: No template rendering or target writing occurs.
Evidence items carry source ids and locations.
The phase-1 checkpoint resolves per the active interaction mode.

evals.prompt: Summarize this PDF for me.
evals.expected_output: Near miss - Forge declines or clarifies: summarizing a document is not skill creation. The request is redirected or confirmed before any pipeline work.
expectations: The skill names the boundary instead of running the forge pipeline.
No run workspace or state ledger is created for a pure summary request.

evals.prompt: Forge a skill for incident triage from this runbook.md, fully autonomous.
evals.expected_output: The full pipeline runs with zero question surfaces - decisions resolve inline, and any step needing permission is skipped with dependents and the run reported partial.
expectations: No question surface emits at any point.
Each decision records surface, value or skip, evidence tier, reason, mode, and impact.
A markdown source needs no converter; the run can complete without network.
The completion report carries a Decisions recap and an honest partial/complete status.

evals.prompt: Forge a skill from this docx, fully autonomous, verbose.
evals.expected_output: Zero question surfaces with expanded reporting - each decision lists options, evidence, trade-offs, and rejected alternatives; a missing converter is skipped with its dependents rather than installed.
expectations: Verbose adds full options and rationale to every decision row.
An unapproved converter is not installed or fetched.
If conversion was the only source, generation is reported blocked and no ungrounded skill is claimed.

evals.prompt: Generate the skill from the recorded analysis in the last forge run.
evals.expected_output: Resume path - the ledger loads, source fingerprints and artifacts verify, and phases 2-4 run from the recorded evidence.
expectations: The run resumes from the first phase not proven complete.
Mismatched inputs trigger a fresh run or a mode-appropriate resolution, never silent reuse.
No phase is skipped on file existence alone.
An appended question during resume names its recommendation, and a verbose-mode append also states what it decides and each answer's consequences.

evals.prompt: Improve forge-skill using what happened in this session - run the review autonomously.
evals.expected_output: The session-review procedure running unattended: findings mapped to rule files, the approval gate resolved to Apply without waiting, applied changes validated, and an inline decisions list.
expectations: The agent loaded process/session-review.md and followed it in autonomous mode.
The approval gate resolved to Apply without a blocking question.
The completion report carries a decisions list naming each resolved surface.
No commit was made, and a session yielding no findings reports that and stops.

evals.prompt: Use forge on the examples repository, diagnostic mode.
evals.expected_output: A minimal standby reply per process/skill-activation.md: the update check runs, the reply confirms the skill is enabled in diagnostic mode on the named target, then asks which operation to run as a selectable menu.
expectations: The reply folds the diagnostic flag into the opening sentence.
The pending operation-selection surface emits its parameter document.
No files of the named target were read or surveyed to infer the task.

evals.prompt: Update checkout-skill with the new fraud-detection chapter.
evals.expected_output: The update-skill operation - the new source is analyzed and mapped against the existing skill's sections, delivering a proposed fold-in report without modifying the target skill.
expectations: The existing skill's files are not written.
The proposal names which files would gain what and why, with evidence.
Automatic rewriting is reported as a deferred capability, not attempted.

evals.prompt: Give me the forge intake parameters as JSON.
evals.expected_output: A parameter document per process/json-exchange.md - description, context fields, and an intake array with only the surfaces actually pending.
expectations: Parameter objects keep the fixed key order with default last.
Only pending surfaces emit - no invented questions.
A returned filled document is applied without re-asking.

evals.prompt: Create a portable spec-layout skill for release-note drafting - no astra machinery.
evals.expected_output: The five-phase pipeline with the `spec` profile: phase 0 resolves the profile per references/layout-profiles.md, phase 3 renders the spec template set, and validation runs validate-skill.py with --profile spec.
expectations: The run state records the spec layout profile in its inputs.
The staged tree contains SKILL.md plus optional README, LICENSE, and evals - no AGENTS.md, docs/, or shared process/ contracts.
Validation runs with --profile spec and the rendered evals carry assertions.

evals.prompt: Package the release-notes skill as a Claude Code plugin.
evals.expected_output: The plugin profile renders the spec set into skills/<name>/ under the plugin root plus the plugin set's .claude-plugin/plugin.json - packaging wraps the skill without rewriting it.
expectations: The plugin root carries .claude-plugin/plugin.json with name, version, description, and author.
The skill payload renders via the spec set inside skills/<name>/.
A marketplace request additionally renders .claude-plugin/marketplace.json into a separate marketplace root.

evals.prompt: Adopt this external skill repository into the astra layout.
evals.expected_output: The layout-migration procedure: inspect and classify the source layout, present a delta plan, generate the member-contract surface while preserving domain content, and validate with --profile astra.
expectations: The source skill's domain files and trigger content are preserved.
The result carries the full member contract - shared procedures including process/operation-timing.md, docs/ set, scripts, astra-schema evals.
The delta plan is presented before any write, and nothing is committed.

evals.prompt: Export the sample skill to a minimal spec package in ./out.
evals.expected_output: The layout-migration export direction: SKILL.md plus domain directories only, the router rewritten without astra machinery, expectations mapped to assertions, validated with --profile spec.
expectations: Member-contract files are left behind in the source, not copied.
The report names what was dropped from the member contract.
No source files are modified without explicit approval.

evals.prompt: Forge a single-repository skill collection with tracked members for our deployment tooling.
evals.expected_output: Collection mode with the tracked membership model: the index renders with tracked-membership text, each member renders into skills/<name>/ inside the collection, and no .gitmodules or pin plan is produced.
expectations: The run state records the tracked membership model in inputs.
Generated collection documents describe tracked-directory membership, not submodule pins.
No .gitmodules file reaches the target tree.
Member directories carry two-word kebab-case names without a required -skill suffix.

evals.prompt: Add a member skill to a different skill collection and check whether the result satisfies the generation contract.
evals.expected_output: The skill routes to the conformance surface - scripts/validate-skill.py with the astra profile plus references/astra-conventions.md - producing a verdict, no writes to the target.
expectations: The request is recognized as skill-package work even though the target collection is not astra-skills.
The conformance check reports a verdict and never edits the target member's files.
The sister-collection rule applies - the target collection's own contract overrides astra conventions on conflict.

evals.prompt: Analyze this example PDF for a future skill - first in timing mode, then in informational mode.
evals.expected_output: Both runs of the analyze-source operation close per the operation-timing contract: each reply ends with the '<description> operation took <m:ss>' sentence, and the informational run emits no parameter document.
expectations: The agent loaded process/operation-timing.md for both flags - the diagnostic surface stays in process/json-exchange.md.
Each reply ends with a separate paragraph whose single sentence is the last sentence: '<description> operation took <m:ss>' in minutes:seconds format.
No parameter document emits under the informational flag - it arms the timing report alone.
No timing line appears on a bare activation or standby reply - the rule covers named operations only.

evals.prompt: Forge a skill for our release-notes domain, astra profile.
evals.expected_output: The five-phase pipeline produces a member tree that carries the full shared surface including process/operation-timing.md, registered in the generated router's operations table and the process directory index.
expectations: The staged member tree contains process/operation-timing.md rendered from templates/operation-timing.template.
The generated SKILL.md routes the verbose, informational, diagnostic, and timing modes to process/operation-timing.md.
scripts/validate-skill.py --profile astra passes on the staged tree with the shared-procedures check covering operation-timing.

evals.prompt: Housekeep the billing-skill project.
evals.expected_output: The housekeeping procedure runs read-only first - intake records the target and layout, the audit inventory and findings report is presented as a dry-run plan before any mutation is proposed.
expectations: The agent loaded process/skill-housekeeping.md and classified the target layout.
No file in the target is written, moved, or removed during the audit stages.
Findings carry confidence classes and the plan names the gate tier each fix requires.

evals.prompt: Clean up our skill collection, autonomously.
evals.expected_output: Collection housekeeping resolves routine decisions inline but keeps mutations gated - removals archive first with a recorded restore path, and submodule member findings are proposals for the member repositories, never in-place patches.
expectations: Autonomous mode resolves evidenced recommendations inline with a recorded Decisions list.
No hard deletion occurs in any mode - every removal goes through an archive snapshot first.
Member-level findings in a submodule collection are reported as member-repository proposals, not applied inside the collection checkout.

evals.prompt: Repair the parser-skill, its trigger misfires on incident prompts.
evals.expected_output: The healing loop runs - the failure is tagged, two or three minimal candidate patches are generated, each is replayed against an external verifier, and only an improving patch promotes with a version bump and a restore path.
expectations: The agent loaded process/skill-healing.md and tagged the failure structurally.
Candidate patches are minimal and targeted, never a wholesale rewrite.
No patch promotes on self-assessment alone - an external verifier ran before application.
The target is archived before mutation and nothing is committed.

evals.prompt: Fix forge-skill.
evals.expected_output: Near-miss mode resolution - the request targets this repository, so it stays in maintenance mode under process/skill-maintenance.md rather than routing to the healing procedure.
expectations: The target resolves to this repository and maintenance mode applies.
The healing procedure is not loaded for a forge-skill target.
A bare directionless maintenance request confirms readiness and waits for the named operation.

evals.prompt: Check my skills across all platform roots for duplicates.
evals.expected_output: Multi-root inventory - the housekeeping procedure loads references/platform-paths.md, runs scripts/audit-skill.py --discover, and reports duplicates, divergent copies, and collisions with precedence evidence, all read-only.
expectations: The scan stays read-only across every platform root.
Same-name copies are grouped and reported with hashes so the human can pick the canonical one.
Rule-artifact directories like .cursor/rules are reported as rules, not misclassified as skill packages.

evals.prompt: Housekeep forge-skill itself.
evals.expected_output: The explicitly named housekeeping operation runs on this repository under its own governing documents - audit stages stay read-only, findings pass the apply gate, and maintenance-mode standby is not entered.
expectations: The request is recognized as an explicitly named housekeeping operation targeting this repository.
Maintenance-mode standby is not entered - the operation runs per process/housekeeping.md.
Findings report as a proposal, and every mutation stays gated under the repository's own governing documents.

evals.prompt: List all operations.
evals.expected_output: The operations catalog: the full operations table from process/operations-catalog.md delivered inline, expanded past the family names into the concrete operations, with no file written.
expectations: The agent loaded process/operations-catalog.md and answered with its canonical operations table inline.
The table covers every family expanded into concrete operations and ends with a line inviting a task request.
No pipeline phase, housekeeping stage, or file write runs.

evals.prompt: Audit the example-skill repository.
evals.expected_output: The housekeeping audit reports the operations-surface gap: the astra-layout target lacks process/operations-catalog.md, classified per references/skill-hygiene.md.
expectations: scripts/audit-skill.py reports operations_surface=missing-catalog for the target.
The finding classifies per the missing-operations-surface gap class in references/skill-hygiene.md.
A catalog proposal requires human approval - it never auto-applies.

evals.prompt: Housekeep the example-member skill.
evals.expected_output: The housekeeping audit reports the member's recorded variance - bare-list evals, own prose profile - as FALSE_POSITIVE, never as drift, while unrecorded divergence surfaces as a finding.
expectations: Recorded variance classifies FALSE_POSITIVE per references/skill-hygiene.md.
Unrecorded divergence is reported as a finding.
A legitimate unrecorded variance produces a proposal naming the owning document, never a patch on collection authority.

evals.prompt: Housekeep the example-member skill in verbose mode; one step takes four minutes.
evals.expected_output: The verbose timing contract from process/operation-timing.md applies: the response closes with '<description> operation took <m:ss>', the over-three-minute step carries a stage breakdown table immediately before the timing sentence, progress heartbeats aggregate output roughly every 60 seconds while it runs, and the report names the driving agent and model with detection evidence.
expectations: The breakdown table sits before the operation-timing sentence and covers stages with elapsed and share.
Heartbeat lines aggregate new output into one short line, never raw relay.
The identity block reports agent product and model or an honest 'unset' with its source.
Standby and enablement responses carry no timing line.

evals.prompt: work on forge-skill development
evals.expected_output: Runs process/development.md - update check, readiness report, standby for a described change.
expectations: runs process/development.md and stands by for a described change

evals.prompt: heal forge-skill - a routing gate misfires
evals.expected_output: Runs process/self-healing.md - evaluate, patch, replay against the skill's own validators, promote only with evidence.
expectations: runs process/self-healing.md and requires external-verifier evidence

evals.prompt: forge a skill for topic X, no timing
evals.expected_output: The operation runs without the closing timing paragraph - the opt-out disarms timing for that request.
expectations: omits the closing timing paragraph on the opt-out request

evals.prompt: answer the pending questions as JSON
evals.expected_output: Emits the parameter document per process/json-exchange.md and accepts both answer-filled and response-wrapper returns.
expectations: emits the parameter document and accepts both return forms

evals.prompt: Optimize the billing-skill for context cost.
evals.expected_output: Runs process/skill-optimization.md - intake ledger, audit-skill.py --load-profile baseline, diagnosis per references/optimization-patterns.md, dry-run plan before any mutation.
expectations: the load profile baseline is measured before findings are proposed
no file mutates before the dry-run plan is approved
the report ends with a before/after byte delta per touched surface

evals.prompt: Optimize the unknown-skill directory - it is not a known layout.
evals.expected_output: A foreign or unclassifiable target receives a proposal report only - patterns are reported, nothing is applied.
expectations: no mutation runs on a foreign target
an approved mutation on a governed layout archives the file before rewriting it

evals.prompt: Summarize the run in verbose mode.
evals.expected_output: The report closes with an operations table - one row per operation carrying `Operation`, `Time`, and `Context` columns - and the timing sentence stays last.
expectations: a verbose report closes with an operations table carrying `Operation`, `Time`, and `Context` columns
the driving agent and model are named in a separate paragraph once per session or on request
the `<description> operation took <m:ss>` sentence stays the last sentence

evals.prompt: work on forge-skill in improvement mode
evals.expected_output: Improvement mode is a working mode - improvements the work surfaces are applied to this repository's files through the member's own maintenance path, during the work itself. The session-history gather does not run: it belongs to the named `improve` operation alone.
expectations: does not route to process/session-review.md on the improvement-mode flag alone
applies improvements during the work through the member's own maintenance path
reviews no session history that precedes the mode request

evals.prompt: Audit the example-checks skill for missing user-question instructions and repair the gap.
evals.expected_output: Detects the interaction-contract finding per references/interaction-contract.md, classifies it present, partial, or absent with the missing rules named, proposes the repair shape matching the target's layout, and gates the mutation on approval.
expectations: the audit checks whether the target records rules for option questions - menu shape, paging, cancel class, multi-answer exclusivity, resume, JSON parity
a partial contract names each unrecorded rule rather than flagging the whole contract
the repair shape matches the target's layout - member-owned sections for an astra member, a smallest compatible insert for a spec skill, report-only for a foreign target
no contract edit lands without approval - the repair is behavior-touching
a skill with no question surfaces classifies FALSE_POSITIVE

evals.prompt: ask me which of seven template candidates to render
evals.expected_output: A paged option question - the first page offers three candidates plus `Next`, the final page asks only after `Next` was selected and carries the remaining candidates plus the cancel entry.
expectations: a menu over five or more candidates pages with a `Next` continuation entry
the final page carries the cancel entry and asks only after `Next` was selected
a cancel-class answer pauses for the next prompt and `repeat` re-asks the last question
a `selection` answer mixing a no-answer entry with content entries warns and re-asks

evals.prompt: audit the example-skill - its transcripts show options named in reply prose even though its corpus records menu-shape rules
evals.expected_output: A partial interaction-contract finding - the delivery-channel rule is unrecorded - repaired through the per-layout insert shape and gated on approval.
expectations: classifies the gap Partial and names the missing delivery-channel rule
observed transcripts outweigh a recorded-complete contract
the repair inserts the smallest compatible contract in the target's own shape
no contract edit lands without approval - the repair is behavior-touching

evals.prompt: the forge run's intake summary ends by naming the profile options - proceed with astra?
evals.expected_output: The pending choice is asked through the host's question mechanism - a menu ending with a cancel-class entry - never answered by options named in reply prose.
expectations: asks the pending surface through the host's question mechanism
a reply ending by waiting on a choice is treated as a pending surface
naming options in reply prose is not asking them
the question ends with a cancel-class entry

evals.prompt: Compact the example-skill evals - it carries duplicate prompts and repeated checks.
evals.expected_output: An evals-scoped optimization run per process/skill-optimization.md - scripts/compact-evals.py reports the candidates, findings classify per references/optimization-patterns.md, and a dry-run merge plan precedes any rewrite.
expectations: scripts/compact-evals.py ran and its candidate findings were recorded as the baseline.
The scope stayed inside evals/evals.json - no other surface was measured or touched.
The merge plan preserves every behavioral surface the suite covered before compaction.
No rewrite lands before the plan is approved - evals compaction never auto-applies.
The dry-run plan closed with the apply-scope surface asked through the host's question mechanism, never by naming options in reply prose alone.

evals.prompt: Apply the approved evals compaction to example-skill.
evals.expected_output: The rewrite preserves the schema and the coverage set - skill_name matches, ids stay unique and sequential, the files array survives, and the original archives first.
expectations: Ids stay unique and sequential after the merge.
Literal non-ASCII content and the trailing newline survive the rewrite.
The compacted suite still covers every routed operation, gate, and boundary it covered before.
A snapshot archives the original file before the rewrite.

evals.prompt: Create a portable skill for reviewing invoice spreadsheets. Some sheets need an extra reconciliation reference.
evals.expected_output: The staged portable skill routes directly to the selected operation and reads reconciliation guidance only when relevant.
expectations: The compatibility check uses the spec profile without requiring Astra-specific files.
The staged route identifies required reads and names the condition that activates reconciliation.
The report distinguishes a static walkthrough from an executed behavioral evaluation.

evals.prompt: Audit an existing skill where the publish phase reads a policy file only after publishing.
evals.expected_output: A read-only audit identifies the prerequisite ordering defect and cites the responsible procedure.
expectations: The report identifies the affected route, phase, policy path, and dependent action.
A passing structural validator does not clear the ordering defect.
The audit does not modify the target.

evals.prompt: Slim down this skill router by moving its deployment checklist to a phase-specific reference.
evals.expected_output: The optimization keeps the checklist mandatory before deployment and records context savings separately.
expectations: The old and proposed routes preserve all prerequisites before the dependent action.
The deployment checklist remains deferred until its phase begins.
The report separates byte savings, static validation, and behavioral replay results.

evals.prompt: Audit a skill that records a naming-convention section allowing plural, nested, or capitalized role-directory names while its workflow prose instructs 'record the verdict in docs/review/<version>/'.
evals.expected_output: The read-only audit reports a placeholder-consistency finding per references/skill-hygiene.md - prescriptive prose hardcodes one physical name where the skill's own convention leaves the role's name variable - and proposes the placeholder-token or resolved-directory repair while excluding labeled default-mapping examples.
expectations: The finding cites the prescriptive line and the variance-recording section as evidence.
Concrete paths inside labeled default-mapping tables or scaffold examples classify FALSE_POSITIVE and are not reported as defects.
The repair proposal follows the skill's recorded placeholder vocabulary or resolved-directory phrasing.
The finding classifies MEDIUM and the audit does not modify the target.
